WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
The Accounts Payable and Freight Cost Management Department provides professional invoice management for all affiliated European BASF Group companies. It cooperates with the procurement and local finance departments, actively involved in the creation of an optimized creditor process chain.

- You are responsible for accounting activities such as checking and posting invoices, clarifying accounts as well as verifying payment runs for our BASF Group Companies in North Europe.
- You will be in charge of analyzing automatically booked invoices as well as of advancing the automation of invoice processing.
- In the optimization of the purchase-to-pay process, you will take an active part and work in close cooperation with the purchasing and finance departments of the BASF Group.
- commercial business training or a degree in Business Administration
- first experience in accounting and projects
- communicative team player who is open to changes
- first experience with SAP
- fluent in English

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 - 39.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location
- Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression
- Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

Your missionWe are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Service Engineer (m/f/d) to join our team in Ulm. In this hands-on role, you will focus on high-precision assembly, internal equipment commissioning, and structured in-house service tasks for our polarizers:Assembly & Commissioning:
• Perform structured assembly, testing, and commissioning of polarizers and sub-assemblies in our manufacturing area according to established technical specifications.
• Execute standardized technical service, maintenance, and pre-delivery checks on in-house units.
• Support hardware, mechanical, electrical, and fluidic component integrations.

In-House Technical Support & Maintenance:
• Carry out routine technical service, inspections, and basic troubleshooting on returned or in-house devices.
• Follow standardized procedures for component replacements, system upgrades, and calibration tasks.
• Document assembly and service activities accurately in our internal systems to maintain high quality standards.

Quality & Inventory Support:
• Ensure high quality and consistency in repetitive manufacturing and service steps.
• Assist with spare parts handling, inventory organization, and preparing service kits for Field Service Engineers.
• Report recurring assembly or component issues to R&D and Quality teams to support continuous product improvement.

Cross-functional Collaboration:
• Provide feedback from service cases, supporting product development and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Management of spare parts, ensuring availability for efficient service operations.

Your profile
• Completed technical vocational training (e.g. Mechatronics, Electronics, Industry mechanics or similar) or an Associate Degree / Technician Diploma or Bachelor in Mechatronics, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
• 1–3 years of hands-on experience in assembly, manufacturing, equipment commissioning, or technical service (experience in MedTech, BioTech, or regulated industries is a plus).
• Solid understanding of mechanical assembly, basic electronics, and fluidic components.
• Ability to read technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions.
• Strong preference for structured, hands-on, and repeatable tasks with high attention to detail and consistency.
• Good communication skills in English; German skills is a plus
• Travel: Very low to none (primarily office/manufacturing-based role in Ulm; travel less than 5%).

Why us?
• Attractive compensation package, including a competitive base salary and stock options
• Key role in a highly advanced and fast-growing startup company
• Impactful product promoting better understanding and treatment of cancer
• International team, from over 30 different nationalities
• Positive work environment with open communication and a collaborative mindset
• Onsite work at state-of-the-art facilities
• Indefinite employment contract
• 30 vacation days
• Flexible working hours
• Annual health budget (Allianz bKV)
• EGYM Wellpass
• Relocation support

About usNVision is innovating quantum technology with a unique approach - leveraging organic molecules to change lives for the better. Our platform spans from quantum signal enhancement that enables metabolic imaging today to quantum computing that could transform drug discovery tomorrow. Headquartered in Ulm, Germany, and backed by leading investors from the United States and Europe, we are now entering a phase of global commercialization and expansion.

With our POLARIS product line, we are extending the capabilities of standard MRIs to enable real-time metabolic imaging, transforming how diseases are detected, understood, and treated. Our work sits at the intersection of physics, engineering, chemistry, and medicine - translating cutting-edge science into clinical reality. We collaborate with leading academic and clinical partners worldwide, including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Technical University of Munich, and the University of Cambridge.

At NVision, we believe transformative innovation happens when talented people from different disciplines work together toward a shared, meaningful goal. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of nearly 160 employees from more than 30 nationalities, driven by curiosity, rigor, and a commitment to solving complex challenges. Here, ideas are valued, ownership is real, and collaboration spans functions, disciplines, and borders.

If you are motivated by impact, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to contribute to something fundamentally new, NVision offers the opportunity to grow while building technology that changes lives.

DIRECTOR, REGULATORY AFFAIRS (F/M/D)

In this role, you'll contribute to the design, development, testing, and continuous improvement of software products while working closely with cross-functional teams in an agile environment. Your work will directly impact the quality, reliability, and performance of technologies used across global clinical trials.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Lead global regulatory activities to ensure compliance with FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, and international medical and non-medical device regulations

*
Define and implement regulatory strategies across the full product lifecycle, from development to post-market

*
Partner with Product Management, Logistics, and Engineering teams to ensure compliant product development and global market access

*
Establish and optimize global processes for trade compliance, import/export, and supply chain regulatory requirements

*
Guide and mentor a team of hardware and software development engineers, providing regulatory expertise across projects such as respiratory, imaging, and cardiac safety solutions

*
Assess regulatory impact of changes to design, materials, labeling, software, and suppliers

*
Support regulatory submissions, including FDA 510(k) filings and international product registrations

*
Review and approve product labeling, technical documentation, and marketing materials to ensure regulatory alignment

*
Participate in internal, external, and vendor audits and contribute to corrective and preventive action initiatives

*
Act as Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) under MDR requirements

*
Oversee the development and maintenance of SOPs and work instructions aligned with global standards

*
Support post-market surveillance, vigilance reporting, and continuous improvement activities

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical field

*
6+ years of experience in the medical device industry

*
4+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within medical devices or pharmaceutical products

*
3+ years of proven leadership experience managing or guiding teams

*
Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, ISO standards, and global medical device requirements (including 510(k) submissions and MDR)

*
Experience interacting with regulatory authorities and supporting audits and inspections

*
Understanding of clinical trial environments and GCP is highly desirable

*
Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills

*
Fluency in English and German

*
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to manage complex regulatory challenges

Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Credit risks are the main underwriting focus in EULA5. The Global Credit Solutions (GCS) team is writing business mainly with global banks by insuring credit risks originated by the banks, where the team assumes the role of a primary insurer. Your task as a Client Relation Risk Manager is to attract new bank clients, manage existing bank clients and writing proactive business within your responsibility. It is necessary to meet credit decision in conjunction with the Risk Underwriting (RUW).
Your Job

- Developing our global business by binding new transactions with new and existing clients
- Establish new and foster existing client relationships, with focus on the global banks. Identify the relevant people within these organisations and establish a personal relationship
- Negotiation and finalizing of insurance policies and Master Risk Participation Agreements with the global banks
- Own risk assessments of the transactions offered by the banks, especially in the area of trade finance
- Assessment of the banks capabilities in originating and assessing credit risks in all relevant trade finance products

Your Profile

- University degree, preferably in business or economics, or equivalent training (banking traineeship followed by relevant further education)
- Several years' professional experience within a bank or professional experience in the risk transfer market between banks and insurance companies in the field of Global Trade Finance
- Proven track record in originating, structuring and closing trade finance and credit risk transactions directly with banks and/or corporates, combined with a demonstrated ability to generate new business opportunities and build long-term strategic client relationships across international markets
- Several years of professional experience in client management and the acquisition and development of international banking and corporate clients
- Strong business development capabilities, including the ability to identify new market opportunities, expand market presence and establish strategic partnerships in key trade finance markets
- Demonstrated experience in establishing, developing and scaling new business areas, products, platforms or market initiatives, ideally in an international environment
- Deep understanding of global trade finance products, risk mitigation structures and relevant international markets
- Strong commercial mindset combined with sound risk assessment capabilities, relationship management skills and the ability to successfully execute complex transactions
- Superior analytical skills in conjunction with a pronounced risk awareness and sense of responsibility, along with a willingness and ability to justify decisions in a clear and comprehensible manner
- Team-oriented, entrepreneurial and solution-driven personality with a high degree of initiative and the ability to work independently
- Business-level English required; additional excellent foreign-language skills an advantage
- Confident manner, high degree of social skills when interacting with colleagues, clients or in-house interfaces

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.
- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.

We help people pipette light. Our optoWELL is a programmable LED illumination platform for 24- and 96-well plates, used by labs worldwide in optogenetics, photopharmacology and photodynamic therapy. We are a small team in Freiburg and sell directly to scientists around the globe. To grow, we need one more person who wants to leave the bench and create a lasting role in our startup with us.

What you will own

- Finding researchers who work with light
- Turning them into qualified leads
- Reaching out, following up, and handing warm conversations over to our CEO
- Keeping the pipeline clean and reporting on it
- A smaller share of routine sales admin (quotes, order confirmations, invoices)

You will not be an assistant. You get a clearly defined area, your own numbers, a documented process to start from – and the freedom to improve it.

What you bring

- Some background in light-based research – or the curiosity to dive into it with us; it is a small, friendly field and we will show you around
- A Master's degree or PhD in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy, chemistry or a related field – you can read a paper and pull out what matters
- Excellent written English; German is helpful for day-to-day work but not required
- You enjoy writing short, personal messages and are not discouraged by the fact that most people don't reply
- Structured, self-reliant work over weeks with a weekly check-in rather than daily supervision; solid Excel skills
- Nice to have: experience with CRM tools or AI-assisted literature work

What we offer

- A proven, documented sales process that already works – you copy it first, then improve it and make it your own if you can
- A role built around one measurable outcome – conversations booked with qualified scientists – rather than a to-do list
- Direct work with the founder, short decision paths, real insight into how a scientific instrument is sold worldwide
- Flexible hours, remote days possible after onboarding, office at the Freiburg Innovation Center (FRIZ)
- €21,000– €25,000 for the 50 % part time role depending on experience. €42,000–50,000 gross per year at full-time equivalent  depending on experience – i.e. ; the same rate applies if the role grows to full-time

What we are really looking for

Someone who is curious about other people's science and would rather understand a lab's actual problem than pitch a product. Someone who works on their own steam, says so when something is not working, and treats scientists and colleagues with the same respect. If that sounds like you, this is not a side role – it is a seat at the core of a small team.

How this works

You will work directly with me, Kathrin – co-founder, CEO, and so far the one doing this job. Send me an email with your CV and two or three sentences on why you want to leave the bench (no cover letter please, and no multi-page AI slop): k.brenker@optobiolabs.com. Then it is simple: a short conversation, a  two- to three-hour trial task so we both see what the job actually feels like, and fast feedback – you will hear from me within a week, either way.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

Apply Now
SAP iXp Intern (f/m/d) - Office of the Head of Product & Engineering of Consumer Industries

Date: 08/26/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What You’ll Build

The SAP Internship Experience Program is SAP’s global, strategic, paid internship program that provides university students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. This is more than an internship; it’s the foundation for a career built on connection, creativity, and impact.

Position title: SAP iXp Intern (f/m/d)– Office of the Head of Product & Engineering  of Consumer Industries
Location: Walldorf, Germany
Internship duration: 6 months (preferred)

Think ahead: In our team we focus on strategic impact. We manage ad-hoc tasks and projects end-to-end while collaborating across functions (e.g. development, product management, UX, Go-to-market, sales, IBU) at SAP. By supporting the Office of the Head of Product & Engineering (P&E)  of Consumer Industries you will have the opportunity to grow your career through collaborating with a talented team, contributing to strengthening the operational & strategic backbone of a global product organization building software for the world’s largest retailer and consumer brands and gaining a deep understanding of how large, global P&E organizations operate.

- Work closely with the Head of P&E for Consumer Industries, his office and his leadership team across functions to drive key internal topics
- Coordinate, support and execute various strategic initiatives under the Head of P&E’s guidance with a focus on product and cross topics, hand-in-hand with key leaders and employees across SAP
- Support preparing internal meetings of the Head of P&E including agenda setting, meeting content and action item tracking; ensuring that expected results are documented and followed up
- Contribute to overarching P&E operating rhythm including portfolio planning, business & products reviews and reporting exercises
- Conduct (market) analysis on product and industry topcis to support crucial management decisions

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who takes the initiative, perseveres, and stays curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.
Student (f/m/d) at a university or a university of applied sciences.

- Currently pursuing or already completed a bachelor's or master's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Economics, Management or a related field
- First (professional) experience in student or management consulting, corporate/product strategy or product-related projects
- Ability to break down complex issues, reduce them to the essential factors and communicate them effectively, attention to detail while also understanding the big picture
- High interest in software, product management, technology, strategy and cross-functional collaboration
- Excellent English communication skills, German is a plus
- At least 4 months availability
- Working from Walldorf office is required. If you are applying from outside the area, please mention your relocation plans or preferences in your CV (Relocation costs are not reimbursed by the manager/employer)

Where You Belong

Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology.

- Culture of Collaboration: Partner with experienced SAP colleagues and expert mentors who will support your growth. Grow professionally through personalized mentoring, coaching, and career development support.
- Project-driven Experience: Kickstart your career with hands-on learning experience, making an impact from day one by contributing to meaningful projects that help the world run better.  You’ll have endless learning resources at your fingertips and gain future-ready skills from a variety of virtual, in-person, and hybrid learning sessions, cultivated just for you, and aligned with our learning approach.
- Gain Visibility: Build relationships with leaders and peers across teams and functions. Showcase your ideas, skills, and creativity in a global, fast-paced environment. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond. You will collaborate with the Head of P&E for Consumer Industries and his office as well as colleagues across the world. Expect guidance where needed and autonomy where helpful, along with direct exposure to leadership decision processes.

Follow @LifeatSAP on Instagram and don't miss anything about our experiences worldwide!

#LifeAtSAP #SAPNextGen

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. jobs.description:
About Huawei

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. With approximately 208,000 employees, we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.

Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes.

Job Title:

Junior Solution Manager for Solar BESS (m/f/d) – Graduate Program

Job Location:

Düsseldorf or Munich, Germany

Main Responsibilities:

As a Junior Solution Manager in our Smart PV Business, you will join the Digital Power Business Group and contribute to delivering innovative digital and power electronics solutions that accelerate the transition toward a smarter, greener energy future. In this role you will handle following tasks:

- Support the evaluation of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions for different application scenarios such as utility-scale projects
- Assist with technical solution design by analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical assessments and supporting project development activities
- Support customer and partner engagement by preparing technical presentations and documentation, and participating in technical discussions
- Engage closely with customers to understand their requirements and technical challenges, recommend suitable solutions from our product portfolio under the guidance of senior team members, and translate customer feedback into input for future product development
- Participate in industry exhibitions, technical workshops and customer events to support technical communication

Requirements:

- Recent graduate student with Bachelor/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with focus on Power Engineering or related technical discipline
- First touch points and passion for renewable energies including but not limited to utility-scale solar, PV, BESS will be an advantage
- Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on defined tasks and effectively collaborate with customers, partners and internal teams

Language requirements:

- Fluency in English and German (C1-C2 level) is mandatory

Huawei's Fresh Graduate Program:

- We offer you an exciting professional career in one of the leading and fastest growing multinational telecommunication companies;
- Personal Development is ensured through training and workshop opportunities in the first 6 months;
- Firsthand experience in customer engagement and new technology innovation;
- Challenging and diverse assignments that enable you to continuously develop your personal and professional strengths;
- Mentor/Buddy Program: A mentor that will guide you through both business and intercultural development;
- After onboarding, internal networking activities with other fresh Graduates take place on a regular basis.

Important: To be considered for this role, applicants must be eligible to work and live in the job location.

Please note that your data will be treated confidentially and securely.
